title: Platform engineer with a security-first software background.
paragraphs: I build the systems around software delivery: source-control governance, CI/CD workflows, internal tooling, release controls, and operational visibility. Because my foundation is full-stack engineering, I understand how teams actually ship software and where controls need to fit.

My strongest independent project is SecureObs, a production-deployed SaaS I designed and built end to end. It brings scanner orchestration, cross-tool deduplication, build gates, tenant isolation, and Terraform attack-path analysis into one workflow.
I am looking for platform engineering and DevSecOps roles where I can combine product-minded engineering with secure defaults, automation, least-privilege access, and practical risk reduction.
